desc: Gear up for everyday concealed-carry with your new Walther PD380 with the Walther PD380 .380 ACP Magazine. This factory magazine features a low-friction, anti-tilt polymer follower and steel wire spring for smooth, reliable feeding, and it boasts wide-cut witness holes that deliver quick, visual round counts for on-the-go reliability at the range or in the field. Precision-machined feed lips provide a snug, wobble-free fit for improved reliability and the polymer floor plate can be easily removed for maintenance and cleaning. This .380ACP magazine boasts lightweight, yet durable stainless steel construction with an ergonomic polymer finger rest floor plate for improved comfort and control when it matters most while still offering snag-free carry.
